writeup: GoSports Splash Pass PRO is a 42-inch floating pool target set that includes four PVC footballs, four PVC baseballs, a pump and a sand bag (model FB-SPLASHPASS-PRO-BLUE). Woot has the blue kit new for $59.99, with 10 or more in stock and a 10-per-customer limit. Dick's Sporting Goods and GoSports both sell the same set for $129.99, and Pool Guy Supply lists it at $169.99, which puts this 53 percent and about $70 below the current street price.
amazon_match_notes: Verifier marked amazon_asin_verified B0BT8CG3V4 as an exact match to the Splash Pass PRO pool football game; Woot condition field was null (treated as new).
